children: Onyx Mesh is now live and open to everyone, giving operators a way to run permissioned Mesh ledgers with trusted ordering, timestamping, and cryptographic verification. The release is the next Onyx product migration and represents the general-availability launch of the project's core permissioned-ledger product, moving it from internal development to broad operational use.

General availability means any organization can deploy a permissioned Mesh ledger without waiting for a staged rollout. Trusted ordering and cryptographic verification address the operational requirements institutions typically cite before running shared ledgers, so the launch tests whether demand exists beyond Onyx's own migration path. For XCN holders, the milestone is concrete but its token relevance depends on actual adoption of the product rather than the release itself.
